Appendix B. Screen Gallery

Every screen of the approved prototype, captured from the prototype with its sample data: 98 screens, followed on the same page by each screen's other tabs and wizard steps (65 states) and every pop-up, warning and side panel it opens (67). The menus of each role (10) close each role's section. Screen IDs and routes match Section 6.6. Pop-ups that only appear for a record in a particular state were captured with that state set, for example Endorse after every blocking comment is resolved.
